title: 第五章 是祸是福第六章 叶不休
lines: 那物。
自然是指，被雷涅封印于摄铃内的黑色能量。
也只有这黑色能量，是这一年以来，雷涅碰到的唯一变数。
不然的话，雷涅也着实想不出。自己到底出了何种问题，竟能违逆境界的进化法则。
雷涅手指掐出道道印结。
顿时！
有着一股强悍波动以雷涅为中心，向四下扩散而出。
这股波动雷涅再熟悉不过，那是神念的威压!
“哈哈哈，果然没猜错!哎？!”
就在雷涅自以为找到了，阻碍自身凝炼神念的罪魁祸首，而欣喜若狂时。
接下来，发生的一幕，让其脸色逐渐涌上寒霜。
只见封印黑色能量的摄铃，刚被召唤出来还急速的摇晃，发出尖锐刺耳的声音。
但其似是突然察觉到了雷涅的存在般，竟在下一秒戛然而止，栽落而下。
雷涅起身，捡起掉落到地上的摄铃，仔细观察了起来。
观其铃身，除了一些地方略有鼓起，其余之处都算正常。
但雷涅并没有因此，放弃当前的举动，反倒是观察的越发仔细，眼睛从上至下地扫过铃身，不漏掉任何蛛丝马迹。
随着时间的流逝，雷涅正常大小的瞳孔逐渐缩小，最后更是达到了针孔粗细！
“等等，这是？！”
雷涅在铃铛的某个部位发现了异处，惊疑出声！
而让雷涅震惊的原因，便在此摄铃的顶部。
那里有着一点极为细小的孔洞，如若雷涅没有这般细至入微的观察，根本无从发现！
就此，雷涅的手开始死死握住摄铃，眼中闪出森森寒芒。
“该死！那黑色能量中的意识的的确确是被我击散了啊！怎么还会出现这种情况？！难不成...其诞生了新的意识？！又或者……黑色能量原先的意识本就有所残留！其隐蔽起来伺机而动，目的便是为了像眼下这般，夺取我的神念本源用以恢复？！”
一想到有此种可能，雷涅几乎做出了要立刻扔掉摄铃的举动。
但！
又想到铃中有着自己凝炼的神念本源。那举起的手最终还是颤抖的放了下来。
雷涅清楚的记得，在某次的宗门大典上，其覆天宗的太上大长老传经授道时说过。
只要踏入真丹境，若想修为有所精进，一定要守住神念的本源之力。而这个神念的本源之力，便是修士在踏入真丹境时，借助增幅数倍的体内玄气，凝化压缩自身的魂念，所产生出的那么一缕精华所在。
可以说，这缕精华是神念修炼的基础，若没了这缕精华，那么任你天赋再高，在往后的修炼之路上，也只能驻足不前！
除非散功重修，否则根本再无进阶的可能！
所以，雷涅这才犹豫不定！
观摄铃一开始散发出的神念波动。他可以笃定，自己的那缕精华必然在其中！
可！
为难自己的关键原因在于，他没法断定黑色能量再次拥有的，究竟是其原先的意识，还是后天产生的新意识。
要是新生的意识，雷涅从其手中夺回神念本源，倒还有着几分把握。
可若是前者的话......
想到这，雷涅双眼开始闪烁不停，其焦躁状态可见一般！
雷涅一开始只是认为：
黑色能量在自己体内存在太久，让自己与其产生了某种联系。
因这种联系，黑色能量才摄取自己凝汇出的神念，于是便导致了自己的神念修炼始终无法寸进。
哪成想，摄铃中的黑色能量竟有着自己的灵智！
content_en:
That thing.
Naturally, it refers to the black energy sealed in the bell by Rene.
This black energy is the only variable that Rene has encountered this year.
Otherwise, Rene really couldn't think of it. What kind of problem did he have that could violate the laws of evolution of the realm?
Rene made a series of seals with his fingers.
Suddenly!
There was a powerful wave centered on Rene, spreading out in all directions.
This wave of fluctuation is all too familiar to Rene, it is the pressure of divine thoughts!
"Hahaha, I guessed it right! Huh?!"
Just when Rene thought he had found the culprit that hindered his ability to condense his spiritual thoughts, he was overjoyed.
What happened next made his face gradually turn cold.
I saw that the bell that sealed the black energy was shaking rapidly and making a sharp and harsh sound just after it was summoned.
But as if he suddenly noticed Rene's existence, he stopped abruptly the next second and fell down.
Rene stood up, picked up the camera bell that fell to the ground, and observed it carefully.
Looking at the bell body, except for a slight bulge in some places, the rest is normal.
But Rene did not give up on his current action because of this. Instead, he observed more carefully, scanning the bell body from top to bottom, not missing any clues.
As time went by, Rene's normal-sized pupils gradually shrank, and finally reached the thickness of a pinhole!
"Wait, this is?!"
Rene discovered something strange in a certain part of the bell and cried out in surprise!
The reason why Reine was shocked was at the top of the bell.
There was an extremely small hole there. If Rene hadn't observed it so meticulously, there would have been no way of discovering it!
At this point, Rene's hand began to hold the bell tightly, and a cold light flashed in his eyes.
"Damn it! The consciousness in the black energy was indeed shattered by me! How could this happen again?! Could it be that... it gave birth to a new consciousness?! Or... the original consciousness of the black energy has remained! It is hiding and waiting for an opportunity, with the purpose of seizing the source of my spiritual thoughts to restore it like it is now?!"
When he thought of this possibility, Rene almost made a move to throw away the bell immediately.
but!
Then he thought that the bell contained the source of his divine thoughts that he had condensed. The raised hand was finally lowered tremblingly.
Reine clearly remembered that at a certain sect ceremony, the Supreme Elder of Futian Sect said this while teaching scriptures.
As long as you step into the true elixir realm, if you want to improve your cultivation, you must keep the original power of your spiritual thoughts. The original power of this spiritual thought is the essence produced by the monk who condenses and compresses his own soul thought with the help of the profound energy in his body that increases several times when he enters the true elixir realm.
It can be said that this essence is the foundation of spiritual cultivation. Without this essence, no matter how talented you are, you will only be able to stand still in the future!
Unless you practice San Gong again, there is no possibility of advancement!
That's why Rene was hesitant!
Observe the fluctuations of spiritual thoughts emitted from the bell at the beginning. He can be sure that his essence must be in it!
Can!
The key reason why he was embarrassed was that he could not determine whether what the black energy possessed again was its original consciousness or a new consciousness that was acquired.
If there was a new consciousness, Rene would have some confidence in regaining the source of his spiritual thoughts from his hands.
But if it's the former...
Thinking of this, Rene's eyes began to flicker, and his anxiety was obvious!
Rene initially just thought:
The black energy has existed in his body for so long that he has some kind of connection with it.
Because of this connection, the black energy absorbs the spiritual thoughts that he has condensed, which results in the inability to make any progress in his spiritual practice.
Who would have imagined that the black energy in the bell actually has its own intelligence!
